newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - General Electric started.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - General Electric started.

text.p: -- Schroder Wertheim said on Monday it started coverage of General Electric Co with a rating of outperform.

-- Analyst David Pizzimenti wrote in a report that reasons for the upgrade included "leading businesses, superb management, earnings growth exceeding that of the market" and "consistent double-digit (earnings-per-share) growth, exceptional cash flow (and) strong balance sheet."
-- The company's stock closed on Monday up 5/8 to 98-1/2.
